one_line: Global tech stocks plummeted amid regulatory and political pressures as major AI companies advanced multibillion-dollar funding and IPO plans.

themes.title: OpenAI and Anthropic financing updates
themes.text: OpenAI closed an $11 billion funding round at a $1.25 trillion valuation while Anthropic pressed forward with its November IPO plans despite global tech sell-offs and flattening AI spending.

stories.headline: OpenAI closes $11 billion in funding at $1.25 trillion valuation
Anthropic presses on with November IPO plans despite global AI stock sell-off
Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO

themes.title: Markets and data centers face headwinds
themes.text: Asian tech stocks plunged following voter-backed ballot measures and political shifts in the U.S. that threaten to delay data center development and increase chip oversight.

stories.headline: Asian tech stocks plunge amid fears US Democrats may delay data centers
U.S. midterm elections bring voter backlash and new restrictions for AI data centers
Democrats plan tighter oversight of Nvidia on chip exports and financing

themes.title: AI research milestones and development speed
themes.text: Physical Superintelligence used a non-public Anthropic model to prove the Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture, as independent findings showed Anthropic's development velocity has doubled.

stories.headline: Physical Superintelligence AI system proves Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture
Anthropic developing AI systems twice as fast as a year ago, report says
